image_description: A single pelican floating on blue water, viewed in profile facing right. The bird has a white and grey plumage with dark flight feathers visible on the folded wing. It features a long, pale pinkish-grey bill with a distinct gular pouch. The neck is curved, and the body sits low in the water.
